name: trenchscope
description: Local Solana memecoin research, rug checks, LARP evidence, and holder analysis over MCP.
long_description: trenchscope exposes 36 MCP tools for Solana memecoin research: token dossiers, holder analysis, security and rug checks, mechanical LARP evidence, candles, trades, knowledge resources, and bounded app navigation. Market and web reads use public or user-configured sources and report missing data as unavailable. MCP actions cannot arm, sign, confirm, or send a trade, raise a signer cap, or change the keypress confirmation gate. The source is AGPL-3.0-only.
